sourceEnglishTitle: Written Daily Report and Deck Repair Documentation
sourceEnglishObjective: Write a clear daily report: work done, deck repairs with photos, materials used and open items
sourceEnglishSpeaking: You are the crew lead and the AI is the office manager taking your end-of-day report by phone: give the hours, the squares completed, the deck repair and materials, and the open items, using report connectors like además, asimismo and por lo tanto.

examples.es: Se completaron 14 cuadros; además, se terminó la limahoya.
examples.en: 14 squares were completed; in addition, the valley was finished.

examples.es: Asimismo, queda pendiente el caballete del lado oeste.
examples.en: Likewise, the ridge cap on the west side is still pending.

example.target: Se completaron 14 cuadros en el lado este.
example.native: 14 squares were completed on the east side.

sourceVerbExamples.note: Written report style, passive se with the preterite: se completó, se completaron.

example.target: Se reemplazaron tres hojas de cubierta podrida.
example.native: Three sheets of rotten deck were replaced.

sourceVerbExamples.note: Preterite: reemplacé (z changes to c), reemplazó.

example.target: Se adjuntan fotos de antes y después.
example.native: Before and after photos are attached.

sourceVerbExamples.note: Common in written reports and emails: adjunto las fotos (I attach the photos).

example.target: Antes de enviarlo, Rogelio leyó el reporte otra vez.
example.native: Before sending it, Rogelio read the report again.

sourceVerbExamples.note: Written accent in the present: envío, envías, envían.

sourceVerbExamples.native: to be missing, still to be done

example.native: In addition, the gutter still needs cleaning.

sourceVerbExamples.note: Falta + infinitive means something still has to be done.

candidateObjective: 作業時間、施工量、野地板の補修、使用資材、未完了項目を日報にまとめる。
candidateFocus: また and さらに add report items; そのため links a finding to the documented repair. ～を添付します identifies the evidence attached to the report.
